notes.title: Patch Notes - May 22nd, 2025
notes.content:
[url=https://www.txchainsawgame.com/hub/patch-notes-may-22][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/edef7e1b-cb4e-4d5d-93aa-123b383ed8b3/TCSM_PatchNotes_05_22_25.png?format=1500w[/img][/url]

Our next patch will start rolling out at roughly 8AM EST on Thursday, May 22nd. 

ICYMI, we have an update on the future of The Texas Chain Saw Massacre which you can read [url=https://www.txchainsawgame.com/hub/tcsm-update]here[/url]. 

[b]Tuned: Base Game - 5% Perks [/b]
[list]
[*] The following perks will now activate at 20% as opposed to under 5% 
[list] [*] ‘Wax On Wax Off’ 
[*] ‘Hush or Die’
[*] ‘I Can Do This’ 
[*] ‘Resilient’ 
[*] ‘I Can Make It’
[/list] [/list]
[b]Tuned: Base Game - Bones’ Gore Bomb Radius [/b]
[list]
[*] Bones Gore Bomb trigger radius is being reduced to match the trigger radius he launched with 
[/list]
[b]Tuned: Base Game - Nancy’s ‘Hurt ‘Em’ Perk [/b]
[list]
[*] The following has been added, “increases the damage dealt to a Victim caught in barbed wire if they continue to run while the barbed wire is attached to them”
[*] There will be 1 HP loss per second for 5/15/30 seconds and the timer starts the moment the barbed wire has been triggered
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Hands’ Barge and Attributes[/b]
[list]
[*] Blood collected from Hands’ barge attack was not properly scaling with attribute points allocated to Blood Harvesting 
[*] Stamina drain after using Hands’ barge attack was also not scaling properly with attribute points allocated to Endurance
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Hands’ Barge[/b]
[list]
[*] We have fixed a bug where after using his Barge, Hands’ stamina would not regenerate as intended
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Connie Star Sign Ability[/b]
[list]
[*] A bug has been resolved that prevented players from immediately progressing the lock picking minigame when activating Connie’s Star Sign Ability
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Grandpa Sonar during Close Encounters[/b]
[list]
[*] Victims were not being properly highlighted to other players when grappling during a Grandpa Sonar
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Leatherface Exploit[/b]
[list]
[*] We have resolved an exploit that allowed players to overhead run in place as Leatherface
[list][*] Leatherface is designed to move forward when sprinting with his chainsaw above his head and will now function as intended
[/list] [/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Leatherface Overhead Slam[/b]
[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue where Leatherface’s overhead slam was not registering properly when Victims would interact with traversals or other objects
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Lockpicking Minigame[/b]
[list]
[*] Lockpicking minigame was able to be progressed without holding the correct alignment in place
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Cook Padlock Progress Reset[/b]
[list]
[*] Progress on a Cook padlock that had been removed and replaced was not correctly resetting
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Sissy, Victims, and Poisoned Items [/b]
[list]
[*] We fixed the issue that caused Victims to not be highlighted after using poisoned health items, Fuses, Valves, and tools if Sissy has ‘Poison Pickup Locations’ equipped 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Danny Bypassing Hands’ Electric Trap[/b]
[list]
[*] When placed on an object that could be inspected, Danny was able to bypass Hands’ Electric Trap and inspect the object successfully 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Matches Ending [/b]
[list]
[*] The issue that caused players to have endless games if the final Victim disconnects has been fixed
[/list] 
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Next Match, Wrong Queues [/b]
[list]
[*] Players will no longer be sent to the wrong queues when they play consecutive matches 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Native Party Invites[/b]
[list]
[*] Accepting a native party invite after a player hits ‘play’ immediately after accepting the invitation will now work
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Close Encounter UI[/b]
[list]
[*] We have made improvements to the flash UI present when in a Close Encounter and flashes will now light up properly with each press
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Clear Eyes’ Highlighting Poisoned Water Pumps[/b]
[list]
[*] Water Pumps that had been poisoned by Sissy were not highlighted as intended for Victims with ‘Clear Eyes’ equipped
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘High Tolerance’ Perk [/b]
[list]
[*] The perk ‘High Tolerance’ will now adjust the highlight duration to poison duration to match the perk description, “Sissy’s poison isn’t as effective on you. Duration is 20%, 40%, 60% shorter.” 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Knock Knock’ Perk [/b]
[list]
[*] The perk ‘Knock Knock’ will now be functional on The Mill 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Deadbolt’ Perk[/b]
[list]
[*] An issue has been resolved where the Perk ‘Deadbolt’ was not applying correctly when attempting to barge latched doors
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Fight and Flight’ Perk[/b]
[list]
[*] We have resolved an issue where the perk ‘Fight and Flight’ was activating during a Close Encounter win animation and the Victim player was not able to move 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Back For Blood’ Perk[/b]
[list]
[*] We have fixed a bug for the perk ‘Back For Blood’ as it was not properly decreasing the Family Bond as intended
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Master Key’ Perk[/b]
[list]
[*] The perk ‘Master Key’ has been fixed as it was giving players infinite charges
[*] The charges at Levels 1-2-3 will be 3/4/5 just as the perk description reads
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Hey Sissy’ Perk[/b]
[list]
[*] A bug has been fixed with the ‘Hey Sissy’ perk where it properly activates only after Nancy interacts with a Mortar table and uses her ‘Spy’ ability
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Rescue Medic’ Perk [/b]
[list]
[*] An issue has been resolved for the perk ‘Rescue Medic’ where it was not applying the proper additional healing that was intended
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘What Doesn’t Kill You’ Perk [/b]
[list]
[*] The team has fixed a bug where the perk ‘What Doesn’t Kill You’ activates in the proper intended scenarios
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Spring Clean’ Perk Equipped on Hands[/b]
[list]
[*] A bug has been resolved where Hands' stamina consumption wasn’t reduced when his Barge attack was used when the ‘Spring Clean’ perk was equipped
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Blood Runner’ Perk Equipped on Hands[/b]
[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue where the perk ‘Blood Runner’ would not activate correctly when it was equipped on Hands while performing a Barge attack
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Nancy’s Traps and Gore Bombs [/b]
[list]
[*] The team has fixed a bug where players couldn’t disarm Nancy’s Barbwired Traps if they were placed on a door that was destroyed by Bones’ Gore Bombs
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Poison Inconsistencies [/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed an issue where poison would not affect Victims consistently when interacting with poisoned generators and car batteries 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Bones’ Gore Bomb Placement[/b]
[list]
[*] While Bones isn’t able to place Gore Bombs directly on the Escape Zones, we have fixed a collision issue where he is not blocked from placing them on the assets near the Escape Zones
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Wyatt’s ‘Knife Throw Interaction’ Ability Upgrade[/b]
[list]
[*] Wyatt’s ability upgrade will now let him disarm Nancy’s barbed wire traps
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Nancy’s Garage Audio [/b]
[list]
[*] Players will now be able to hear Leatherface’s chainsaw audio from outside of Nancy’s garage 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Skipping Overheat Slam Attacks [/b]
[list]
[*] Victims will no longer be able to skip a knockdown animation after Leatherface hits them with an overheat slam attack 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Parties and Wrong Lobbies [/b]
[list]
[*] Players in parties will no longer be separated and placed in different lobbies when playing consecutive matches and will all go to the same lobby together
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Nancy’s Traps [/b]
[list]
[*] We fixed the issue that prevented Nancy’s traps from being disarmed when placed on a door destroyed by Leatherface 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Gaps on Mill [/b]
[list]
[*] Family members will no longer be able to attack Victims if they are on the other side of a gaps 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Poisoned Items on Mill [/b]
[list]
[*] Sissy will now be able to poison the health item that spawns in the Silos area 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - ‘Don’t Touch’ Achievement [/b]
[list]
[*] Sissy’s ‘Don’t Touch’ achievement will now unlock properly 
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Mill Hiding Volumes [/b]
[list]
[*] Bushes in the Overgrown Exterior, Cotton Field, and Ghost Town area match their hiding volumes now
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Johnny’s Door Barge[/b]
[list]
[*] We have fixed a UI bug where Johnny would receive two button prompts to barge a door, only one button prompt will appear as intended
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Hands’ Barge Button Input[/b]
[list]
[*] The button input for Hands’ Barge was incorrect for preset 2
[*] We also fixed the incorrect labeling of his barge when choosing preset 2 for controller mapping on PC
[/list] 
[b]Fixed: Base Game - Flooded Area on Graveyard[/b]
[list]
[*] We have adjusted the water speed of the flooded area on the Graveyard map to look more natural
[/list]
[b]Fixed: ‘Rush Week’ - Removed Map Selection Option[/b]
[list]
[*] We have removed the UI for map selection in lobby as there is only one map option for players  
[/list]
[b]Fixed: ‘Rush Week’ - Fear Meter[/b]
[list]
[*] Calling the police via the car radio was not properly decreasing the Fear meter for Sorority Girls
[/list]
[b]Fixed: ‘Rush Week’ - Door Latched Prompt[/b]
[list]
[*] A crossed out ‘door latched’ prompt has been removed that would display when players approached an unlatchable door
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Museum Mode - Title Crash[/b]
[list]
[*] We have resolved title crashes that would occur in the following situations
[list] [*] Accepting an invite while in the Museum Mode loading screen
[*] Opening and closing other game modes before entering Museum Mode
[*] Immediately returning to the main menu after opening Museum Mode
[/list] [/list]
[b]Fixed: Private Matches - Title Crash[/b]
[list]
[*] Players would experience a title crash as the host if a non-host player repeatedly pressed the select map prompt after concluding a match
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Private Matches - Disabling Character Abilities[/b]
[list]
[*] Objects would still be highlighted for Danny when character abilities were disabled by the host of a private match despite him being unable to investigate or tamper them
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Private Matches - Opposing Team Perk Effects [/b]
[list]
[*] Perk effects will no longer be visible to opposing team players
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Private Matches - Nancy’s Barbed Wire Visibility[/b]
[list]
[*] When the host player is Nancy, their barbed wire will now be visible to all players as intended
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Private Matches - Well Camera Clipping[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed visual camera clipping that would occur when Victims jumped through wells
[/list]
[b]Fixed: Private Matches - ‘Noise Pollution’ Perk [/b]
[list]
[*] The perk ‘Noise Pollution’ will no longer activate for the private match host as intended 
[/list]

Thank you for reading the patch notes. Keep up with our studio on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@fearthegun]Tiktok[/url], [url=https://x.com/fearthegun]X[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/fearthegun/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/GunInteractive/]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: An Update on the Future of The Texas Chain Saw Massacre, DLC, and What's Next
notes.content:
Just a couple of years ago, if you sat down and asked anyone here at Gun Interactive what would be a dream project for them… you’d hear them say The Texas Chain Saw Massacre. A pivotal film for any horror lover – innovative, indie, and artistic – Gun brings that same spirit to making games. Being able to see The Texas Chain Saw Massacre get into the hands of players is one of the proudest accomplishments we’ve had as a studio. 

We feel proud of the game we’ve made and we’re happy that we’re at a point where we feel The Texas Chain Saw Massacre has reached its full potential. From the very beginning, we’ve always had a clear and concise vision for this game. We wanted to push the envelope on multiplayer asymmetrical horror, shed light on this iconic film to a newer generation, and place folks into the beautiful but macabre world of Muerto County and we feel we have achieved that. 

For instance, telling the story of Maria Flores and her friends while bringing horror icons into the franchise like Kane Hodder, Barbara Crampton, Scout Taylor Compton, and Skeet Ulrich was incredibly rewarding and important to us. While creating something new, we still sought to honor the 1974 film authentically, working from Kim Henkel’s character bible as well as bringing back franchise favorites Bill Mosely and Ed Neal. And at this point, we feel that we have seen The Texas Chain Saw Massacre fully realized. 

With that being said, The Texas Chain Saw Massacre will not be receiving any further future content or support. This means that there will be no more DLC, balance updates, or bug fixes, after our upcoming May patch. You can still expect a few more patches in the future in order to transition towards peer-to-peer matchmaking. The Texas Chain Saw Massacre will still be playable and is NOT being delisted from store fronts. Our community team will continue to interact with our players as we continue to celebrate The Texas Chain Saw Massacre with all of you who love this game just as much as we do.  

As a creative studio, it’s imperative to communicate that we’ve seen this vision through to the natural creative end. We are a scrappy group of horror heads and artists continuously working on bringing cinematic experiences to you all. We appreciate the folks who understand the vision we are bringing to the asymmetrical multiplayer horror space because let’s face it, it may not be for everyone. But those who get it, those who have widened their gaming circles to play The Texas Chain Saw Massacre, those who have reveled in the terror, horror, and beauty of this world with their friends keep us motivated and ready to continue to do what we do best… make your favorite horror games. We wouldn’t have it any other way. 

What’s next for Gun?

…STAY TUNED.

Fans of the studio can keep up with what is next for Gun Interactive on [url=https://x.com/fearthegun]X[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/fearthegun/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@fearthegun]TikTok[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes - March 20th, 2025
notes.content:
[url=https://www.txchainsawgame.com/hub/patch-notes-march-20th][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/6f3ba027-bade-4b71-a842-e097d2130e33/TCSM_PatchNotes_03_20_25.png?format=2500w[/img][/url]

[b]Our March 20th, 2025 patch notes features bug fixes, the release of both Sunday Best and Denim Outfit Packs, and more. [/b]

Our March patch will start rolling out across consoles and PC at roughly 8AM EST on Thursday, March 20th. This patch includes the release of the Sunday Best and Denim Outfit Pack, both of which are included in the Content Pass. 

Players who have a Content Pass will automatically unlock Sunday Best and the Denim Outfit Pack. For non-Content Pass holders, the packs are $4.99 USD each. 

Sonny Outfit Pack III will also be available for purchase for $4.99 USD. 

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]
[b]Tuned:[/b] Base Game - Bones’ Gore Bombs 
[list]
[*] The blast damage radius for Bones’ Gore Bombs has been increased  
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Interactions
[list]
[*] The team has made further adjustments to the ensure that traversal options are prioritized over item pick ups 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Close Encounters
[list]
[*] A bug was fixed for close encounters in private matches where the host player would win a grapple in situations that they should’ve lost
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Execution Pack IV’s Black Bars
[list]
[*] The team has fixed the aspect ratio for the cinematics of Execution Pack IV
[*] The black bars are now removed to mirror previous released executions
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Bones Spawn on Slaughterhouse Maps
[list]
[*] Our team has fixed issues with Bones spawning in incorrect locations on all Slaughterhouse variants
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Gore Bombs 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed Bones to place Gore Bombs mid-air in escape zones
[*] We have also fixed the issue where Bones Gore Bombs couldn’t be triggered and/or retrieved on certain corners and assets 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Wyatt ‘Awareness Team’ Ability Upgrade
[list]
[*] A bug impacting the ‘Awareness Team’ upgrade has been fixed where Family Members hit by Wyatt's knives would not be highlighted for all Victims
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Wyatt Knives Interacting with Hands’ Ripstall
[list]
[*] An issue was present where Wyatt could turn off the generator during Hands’ Ripstall minigame and would sometimes result in:
[list][*] Players being unable to interact with the generator for the remainder of the match
[*] Wyatt was able to throw another knife to receive XP for turning off the generator when it was already turned off [/list] [*] This issue has been fixed and Wyatt can no longer interact with the generator during Hands’ Ripstall minigame
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Wyatt’s Knife Bypassing Electric Traps 
[list]
[*] We have fixed a bug where Wyatt’s Throwing Knives would disable an Electric Trap and turn off the Generator or Battery in a single knife throw
[*] It will now take one Throwing Knife to disable an Electric Trap and one Throwing Knife to turn off an objective
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Bone Charm Collision with Wyatt Knives
[list]
[*] Our team has fixed an issue where Wyatt’s Knives were being blocked by collision from a specific type of bone charm
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Wyatt Star Sign Ability during Escape Cinematic
[list]
[*] We have fixed Wyatt being able to use his ability while escaping, which would result in sliding movement and a visible crosshair during spectating
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Bypassing Animations 
[list]
[*] We fixed the bug that allowed Family players to bypass the animations for setting traps, closing doors and locking doors
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Hands’ Barge Animation
[list]
[*] Hands players were able to skip his successful barge animation if they performed interactions such as collecting blood, ripstalling, hooking up electric traps, etc 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Family Animations 
[list]
[*] We fixed the bug where when a Family member would walk through the valve exit, the Family member would get stuck in their walking animations for a brief period of time
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Native Invites
[list]
[*] We have fixed the issue where the native invite prompt did not always show up for PS5 players in custom lobbies 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Leatherface’s Overhead Slam
[list]
[*] The team has fixed the issue that caused Leatherface’s overhead slam attack to not register if a Victim was traversing crawlspaces, stabbing Grandpa, or interacting with the valve 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Hands’ Barge
[list]
[*] An issue has been resolved where Hands’ initial barge attack would not function as intended, resulting in the player becoming softlocked
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - ‘No Sell’ and Hands’ Barge
[list]
[*] We have fixed a bug where the perk ‘No Sell’ was not using charges properly when getting barged by Hands 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - ‘Protective Aura’ Perk 
[list]
[*] The team has fixed the issue where the perk ‘Protective Aura’ did not reduce damage when a victim was pulled out of a hiding spot 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - ‘Rally Leader’ Perk
[list]
[*] Fixed the perk ‘Rally Leader’ which was only functioning for the perk holder instead of all Victims per its description, “Help all Victims recover from being incapacitated more quickly. Recovery is 15/25/35 % faster.”
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - ‘Fish Hooks’ Perk
[list]
[*] ‘Fish Hooks’ was not working as intended at Level 2 and Level 3 and will now work as described, “Sneak attacks decrease Family’s max stamina for a limited amount of time. Max stamina is reduced by 50/65/75% for 10/20/30 seconds.”
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - ‘Slippery’ Perk 
[list]
[*] ‘Slippery’ is now fixed so that the perk activates after a player finishes traversing through a gap 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Danny Knows Engines
[list]
[*] We have fixed a bug where the ‘I Know Engines’ Perk wouldn’t activate within the proper ranges when equipped on Danny
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - ‘Swinging For the Fences’ on Bones
[list]
[*] An issue has been fixed with the Grandpa Perk ‘Swinging For the Fences’ where it was not applying to Bones when the perk was active
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Virginia’s SFX 
[list]
[*] We have fixed the bug where the SFX for Virginia contaminating a blood bucket continued if she canceled out of the interaction 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Johnny’s Footprint Tracking 
[list]
[*] The bug that caused Johnny’s footprint tracking to remain active if he was electrocuted on the cattle grid is now fixed 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Disappearing Health Potions
[list]
[*] We have fixed the bug that caused poisoned health potions to completely disappear from the map if it was swapped out for another item
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Minigame UI Disappearing 
[list]
[*] The team has fixed the issue that caused the minigame UI for toolbox gathering, lockpicking, bone pile gathering, turning on the generator, and solving the fusebox to disappear if done after winning a grapple 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Lockpicking Minigame 
[list]
[*] We have fixed the bug that caused the lockpicking minigame to wiggle rapidly when trying to complete it
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Victims Permanently Highlighted
[list]
[*] Victims becoming permanently highlighted after Grandpa is immobilized for a second time by Wyatt’s Star Sign Ability has been resolved
[*] We have also fixed more instances where Victims would become permanently highlighted after being caught by Grandpa’s Sonar
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Gore Bombs Crashing
[list]
[*] We’ve resolved an issue in public and private matches where players were experiencing title crashes when Bones and at least 3 Victims were hit by the same Gore Bomb
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Rain Effects Inside Containers - Slaughterhouse - Storm
[list]
[*] Instances where rain effects were present on props inside of the containers on Slaughterhouse - Storm has been fixed
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Wyatt Portrait Resolution
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed an issue where Wyatt’s portrait would sometimes appear low in resolution when viewed via the Customization tab
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Hitchhiker Chestburster Execution FPS
[list]
[*] We have made improvements to decrease FPS drops during Hitchhikers Chestburster Execution
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Player XP on Graveyard
[list]
[*] Our team has fixed a bug where Victim players were not receiving the proper XP when exiting the basement and other boundaries on the Graveyard map
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Virginia’s Skill Tree
[list]
[*] A bug has been resolved with Virginia’s Skill Tree where despite adjacent nodes being unlocked, a branch path on the right was not visible
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Floating Assets
[list]
[*] We’ve resolved an issue that would cause floating assets or items in the following locations
[list][*] The Mill - Riverbed area
[*] Slaughterhouse (including Leatherface’s Lair) [/list] [/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Missing Gore on Slaughterhouse 
[list]
[*] We fixed the problem where gore was missing from Leatherface’s Lair on all Slaughterhouse map variants 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Hitchhiker Wall Gap Stuck Spot
[list]
[*] Our team has resolved an issue where Hitchhiker would become stuck when going through the wall gap that connects the West Cell and Dig Room on Nancy’s House with ‘Wire Frame’ equipped
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Gas Station Stuck Spots 
[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue where both Family and Victim players would get stuck in the crawl space and gaps in the Tool Storage area
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Ladder Stuck Spots
[list]
[*] The following ladder stuck spot locations have been fixed 
[list][*] Tool Shed - Gas Station 
[*] Ladder Thicket - Gas Station 
[*] Garage Ladder - Slaughterhouse [/list] [/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Valve Stuck Spot
[list]
[*] We have fixed the bug that caused Victim players to get stuck in the valve if they spammed open the valve and proceeded to get hit by a Family member on Slaughterhouse and Gas Station
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Family House Lighting 
[list]
[*] We have fixed unnatural lighting located by the shed in the Front Field area  
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Slaughterhouse Lighting 
[list]
[*] The lighting in the Holding Pen Area of the Slaughterhouse was too dark and has since been fixed 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Church Basement Lighting on Graveyard 
[list]
[*] We have fixed a lighting issue where parts of the Church Basement on the Graveyard map appeared darker than intended
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Slaughterhouse Tree Collision
[list]
[*] Multiple trees were missing collision on Slaughterhouse and collision is now present
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Collision on Slaughterhouse
[list]
[*] The team has resolved an invisible collision issue that players could climb onto next to the Crawlspace in the Feed Storage on all of the Slaughterhouse map variants
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Collision on Graveyard
[list]
[*] We have resolved an issue where players could walk on top of invisible assets near the Graveyard Entrance area 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Collision on Gas Station
[list]
[*] An issue has been resolved where players could walk on top of an invisible asset located in the Shed Basement area of the Gas Station map 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Nancy’s House Collision 
[list]
[*] The team has removed invisible collision located in the North Tunnel area that blocked players movement 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - ‘Sensed Victim Fear’ Notification
[list]
[*] We have fixed a UI bug where Johnny players would only receive the ‘Sensed Victim Fear’ UI notification once per match
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Vent Access
[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue where Vent access wouldn’t become unavailable immediately after it was destroyed
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Environment Collision
[list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 26th, 2024
notes.content:
[b]Read on for the tunes, changes, and fixes coming to TCSM on November 26th, 2024.[/b] 

Our November 26th, 2024 patch will start rolling out across consoles and PC at roughly 8AM EDT. This patch will also include the release of the Summertime Outfit Pack (this will unlock automatically for Content Pass holders), Ana Outfit Pack III, and Julie Outfit Pack III. We have Blackout Cosmetics  for Hands, Maria, and Virginia for all Level 99 players releasing, as well. 

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]
We wanted to share with players some known issues that were found late in testing for tomorrow’s patch.

[b]Known Issues: [/b]
[list] [*] [strike]Some players may experience server errors when trying to unlock the perks 'Unrelenting' and 'Dracula' in Hands Skill Tree [/strike] [list] [*] EDIT: This issue has been resolved prior to deploying this patch - 11/26/2024 [/list] [*] Players loading into 'Rush Week' may experience prolonged wait times for player refills if players leave the lobby [*] Players may experience native invites not functioning properly for Private Matches [list] [*]Current workaround is joining a party before loading into a Private Match [/list] [/list] Please note that these known issues are being worked on by our teams for a fix that will launch outside of our usual patch cadence. The testing and certification process may be affected by the holiday. Thank you for your patience.

[b]Changed[/b]: Base Game - Hands Skill Tree
[list] [*]We have removed ‘Scout’ from Hands Skill Tree
[list] [*]‘Scout’ will be replaced by ‘Unrelenting’
[*]‘Dracula’ will replace the previous node for ‘Unrelenting’
[*]Please Note: Players who own Hands will have to respec his Skill Tree [/list] [/list]
[b]Changed[/b]: Base Game - Custom Private Match Toggles 
[list] [*]We have added a toggle for item spawn rates
[*]They are half and double [/list]
[b]Changed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Fusebox Minigame Instructions
[list] [*]Text for the Fusebox Minigame has been updated
[list] [*]Previously it read “Match the round fuse color with the correct slot, ensuring the AMP value is met for each pair. Once complete, power will be restored and the basement exit will open temporarily”
It will now correctly read, “Match the round fuse color with the correct slot, ensuring the AMP value is met for each pair. Once complete, power will be restored” [/list] [*]We have also updated the text players will see upon successful completion of the minigame
[list] [*]Previously it would state, “Basement Exit Opened”
[*]Now it will read, “Success” [/list] [/list]
[b]Changed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Slammed Doors on Johnny

[*]We have added a notification at Level 3 which will read, “Slammed doors now break on Johnny” [/list]
[b]Tuned[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Fear Rebalancing 
[list] [*]Sorority Girls will now start with some Fear and different visual effects
[*] Previously, Sorority girls would start a match with no Fear [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Danny’s Tamper UI
[list] [*] We have fixed a visual bug where a Danny player would use their Tamper with at least half of the knowledge bar filled, but the Tamper minigame UI would fill up completely
[*] Danny’s Tamper minigame will now display visually the correct knowledge added [/list] 
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Danny Star Sign Ability Cancellation 
[list] [*] An issue has been resolved where progress made by applying knowledge in the Tamper minigame was reset if a Danny player attempted to progress the minigame before the entire Knowledge charge could fully apply
[*] Progress made in the minigame will now apply correctly [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Leatherface Exploit
[list] [*] The team has fixed an issue where Leatherface players could bypass the opening animation of doors and gates by running towards the door/gate, revving, and swinging their chainsaw at the same time
[*] Leatherface can no longer melee attack while opening a door or a gate [/list]

[list] [*] We have resolved an issue where all Grandpa Perks equipped in the match were intermittently activating at Family Bond Level 1 regardless of their level
[*] Grandpa Perks will now activate at their correct levels [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Background Elements
[list] [*] We have resolved an issue where a patch of grass would be misplaced in the UI [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Barge Animation
[list] [*] An issue has been fixed where players were able to cancel their barge animation in order to barge a door faster than intended [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Blood Issues
[list] [*] Blood was incorrectly washing away from characters after being wounded [list] [*] We have fixed this issue, and now blood will remain on players unless they are exposed to rain [/list] [*]We also resolved an issue where no blood would show when a player took damage
[list] [*] Blood will now correctly display when taking damage or jumping out of a window [/list] [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Localization
[list] [*]We have added localization in available languages for the following
[list] [*]Execution Pack IV names and descriptions
[*]Maria Outfit Pack I names [/list] [/list] 
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Gas Station Storm Textures
[list] [*]We fixed issues with rain textures being incorrectly applied to characters when inside
[*]Now the correct textures will only display when outside [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - ‘Choose Fight’
[list] [*]Our team has fixed an issue where ‘Choose Fight’ was not extending the stun duration for sneak attacks properly [*]‘Choose Fight’ should now correctly extend Family Member stun duration after a sneak attack by 2/3.5/5 seconds [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - ‘Rough Cut’ Activation 
[list] [*] ‘Rough Cut’ has been fixed to where the perk will activate every time Leatherface attacks a Victim [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - PlayStation Native Invite Issues
[list] [*]There was a bug that would cause a player to remain in a state of infinite loading if they accepted a native invite for a custom lobby or party when in a public lobby 
[list] [*] This has now been fixed [/list] [*]Players would occasionally receive a network error when accepting a native invite while in a custom lobby or in a party 
[list] [*] Network Errors will no longer occur when accepting a native invite [/list] [/list] 
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Localization 
[list] [*] ‘Unique Nancy’s House Escapes’ Stat is now localized for all supported languages [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Sneak Attack Illogical Distances 
[list] [*] We fixed the issue where Victims were able to Sneak Attack Family members from illogical distances [*] Now, the Sneak Attack prompt will only appear when a Victim player is close enough to do so [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Climbing Wells 
[list] [*] The bug that caused players to be able to climb on top of certain wells on Slaughterhouse, Nancy’s House, and The Mill has been fixed
[*] Players will no longer be able to climb on top of those wells [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Stuck Spots 
[list] [*]The stuck spot at the Cotton Fields on The Mill has been fixed [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - ‘Suffocating Grip’ Perk 
[list] [*]‘Suffocating Grip’ was making the close encounter minigame more than 25% easier for Family members [*] The perk will now work as intended [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - ‘Bar Room Hero’ Well Issue
[list] [*] We fixed the bug where if a player had the perk ‘Bar Room Hero’ equipped, they would get stuck upon falling down a well [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Wells and Desync 
[list] [*]We fixed an issue where Victim players would lose the ability to interact with items or desync from a match after they became incapacitated from jumping down a well [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Cook Padlock Exploit 
[list] [*]There was an exploit where a Cook player could add one of his padlocks to a door or gate and saved minigame progress would transfer to his padlock instead [*] Now, when Cook places a padlock on a door or gate with saved minigame progress, the progress will remain on the door/gate regardless of Cook’s padlock [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - Party Disbanding and Restarting 
[list] [*] We fixed the issue where when a lobby closes due to not enough suitable players, the party would disband and players couldn’t join a party until they restarted the entire game [*] Players will no longer experience this [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Base Game - ‘Security Pins’ 
[list] [*] We fixed the bug that resulted in ‘Security Pins’ not increasing the difficulty of the lock picking minigame [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - UI Localization
[list] [*] We have updated the 'PREFER TO PLAY AS VICTIM' text to be localized in every language available in the game [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Red Phone Cable Textures 
[list] [*] We have fixed the textures of the phone cable that was stretching to the Sorority Girl’s location [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Pepper Spray Clipping
[list] [*] We have resolved an issue where Pepper Spray was not correctly aligned while being used in a Sorority Girls' hands [*] Pepper Spray will now be correctly aligned with the Sorority Girls' animation [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Softlocked With Options Tab Opened
[list] [*] We fixed an issue where softlocking occurred for the 6th or 7th player if they loaded into a match while ‘Options’ is open in a lobby [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ -Softlocked in Rush Week’s Main Menu
[list] [*] We have fixed a bug where players be would softlocked after pressing the chat function button or key at the Rush Week main menu [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Johnny’s Camera
[list] [*] An issue has been resolved in Rush Week where a Johnny player’s camera was stuck inside the character model after starting the match [*]The camera will now be positioned behind the character [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Softlocked in Rush Week Lobby
[list] [*] We have resolved an issue where 6 players in a Rush Week lobby couldn’t change tabs or access any menus [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Sorority Girl Cinematic
[list] [*] An issue has been fixed where a Sorority Girl’s leg was deformed during the cinematic intro of a match [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Stuck Spot
[list] [*]Players would become stuck behind the front double doors, between the doors and occasionally get stuck in in-game assets [*] We have fixed this issue [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Localization
[list] [*] Halloween Outfit names are now correctly localized in available languages [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Vents
[list] [*] An issue has been fixed where vents would remain ‘in use’ throughout a match [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Inconsistent Wounds 
[list] [*] There was an issue where wound marks would appear inconsistent on the Halloween Outfits in ‘Rush Week’ [*] Now, wound marks will be correct [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: ‘Rush Week’ - Multiple Car Keys 
[list] [*] We fixed the bug where more than one pair of car keys would spawn in multiple locations [*] Now, only one pair of car keys can spawn in select, random locations [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Private Matches - Boon SFX 
[list] [*] There was an issue where the SFX for Virginia’s Boon would play in a loop at the location where she initially used her Boon [*] This will no longer occur [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Private Matches - Crashes 
[list] [*] The game would crash when the party host would establish a custom lobby with at least one other player [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Private Matches - Non-Functional Native Invites 
[list] [*] We fixed the issue where a native invite would not show up for a non-host player after they’ve joined the lobby via a code 
[*] Now, when a player joins a lobby with a code, a native invite will work as intended [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Private Matches - Missing Generator SFX 
[list] [*] The audio for the generator was missing for whoever was the host of a custom private match 
[*] Players who host a custom private match will now be able to hear the generator SFX [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Private Matches -  Host Spectating Bug
[list] [*] A bug has been fixed where the host couldn’t see a Victim’s character model in spectator mode after the player finished the Fuse Box minigame [*] The Host of a Private Match can now see all character models in spectator mode [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Private Matches-  Visual Bug for Host in Spectator Mode
[list] [*] We have fixed a visual bug where the host of a private lobby couldn’t see the Proximity Warnings while in spectator mode [*] Proximity Warnings will now be visible for a host in spectator mode [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Private Matches - Perks Not Saving to Loadout
[list] [*] The team has fixed an issue where a Player would rejoin a custom lobby after conclusion of a match, swap to a character they did not play with in the previous match and their perk slots would unequip in their loadout [*] Character perks will now stay equipped in their loadout when moving onto another private match lobby [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Private Matches - Crawl Space Sound FX
[list] [*] We have fixed an issue where the Sound FX of the Crawl Space hitting the ground was not present when the action was canceled [*] The Sound FX of not completing the opening of a Crawl Space will now be present [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Private Matches - Localization
[list] [*] Customization prompt and settings are now correctly localized in available languages [/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]: Private Matches - Lobby Customization
[list] [*]We have fixed an issue where a non-host player was able to change Private Match settings in Lobby
[*]Now only the host can access the customization menu [/list]

For any existing or persistent issues, please use the support site.

Thank you for reading the patch notes. Keep the conversation going on our official subreddit, r/TXChainSawGame, Tiktok, Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook.

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 22nd, 2024
notes.content:
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/5aafa170-8ba1-4675-9087-af93093447db/BBQ_SocialUpdates_PatchNotes_10_22_24.jpg?format=2500w[/img]

[b]Grapple Reworks, Gas Station - Storm, and bug fixes are featured in our upcoming October 22nd, 2024 patch.[/b]

Our October 22nd, 2024 patch is scheduled to start rolling out across console and PC at roughly 8AM EDT. This patch will also include the release of a new map variant, Gas Station - Storm, Maria Outfit Pack I, Hands Suspenders Outfit, and the Halloween ‘Rush Week’ Pack. 

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/c8037808-16e5-461f-b668-bbd680eeed63/TCSM_Hands_AvailableOctober22.png?format=2500w[/img]

As a reminder, the Towel and Laundry Day cosmetics in ‘Rush Week’ are moving to paid DLC at $1.99 USD each. 

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/1ff5d611-7040-474b-b426-0ae96a184e8f/TCSM_RushWeek_Cosmetics_Five.png?format=2500w[/img]

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]
[b]Changed:[/b] Close Encounters/ Grapples 
[list]
[*] Each character will now have a grappling value assigned to them to determine their effectiveness in a close encounter
[*] Read the full changes [url=https://www.txchainsawgame.com/hub/grapple-reworked-explained]here[/url]
[/list]

[b]Tuned:[/b] Custom Private Match Toggles 
[list]
[*] The following toggles are now available in custom private matches 
 [list]
[*] Victim Health - Half, Default, Double
[*] Family Damage - Half, Default, Double
[*] Character Abilities - Enable or Disable
[*] Character Perks - Enable or Disable
 [*] HUD toggle - Enable or Disable
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Tuned:[/b] ‘Rush Week’- Johnny’s Melee Damage
[list]
[*] We have slightly increased the amount of melee hits it takes to execute a Sorority Girl
[*] It will now take Johnny 3 hits to execute a Sorority Girl
[/list]

[b]Tuned:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Johnny’s Lockpicking
[list]
[*] We have increased Johnny’s Proficiency
[*] Johnny will now be able to lockpick doors faster
[/list]

[b]Tuned:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Johnny Door Stuns
[list]
[*] Johnny’s stun time from door slams has been decreased
[/list]

[b]Tuned:[/b] ‘Rush Week’- Attic Pole Spawns
[list]
[*] We have updated the amount of spawn locations for the Attic Pole
[*] The Attic Pole will now spawn farther away from Sorority Girls
[/list]

[b]Tuned:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Sorority Girls Vent Damage 
[list]
[*] We have decreased the damage that Sorority Girls take from falling out of a vent
[*] They will no longer receive damage 
[/list]

[b]Fixed: [/b]Base Game - Grandpa Perks
[list]
[*] Activation levels for Grandpa Perks has been fixed, and will activate at the correct Family Bond level
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Blood Trails 
[list]
[*] We fixed an issue where blood trails were no longer showing up for either Victim or Family Players 
[/list]

[b]Fixed: [/b]Base Game - Door and Gate Inconsistencies 
[list]
[*] We have fixed a bug that caused Family members to not properly open doors and gates 
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - ‘Clear Eyes’ 
[list]
[*] Electric Traps set by Hands that were disabled or triggered were not highlighting for Victims with ‘Clear Eyes’
[list]
[*] This has been fixed to be consistent with Hitchhiker’s traps and Nancy’s barbed wires, which are highlighted even after being triggered
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - ‘Fast Hands’
[list]
[*] Issues with ‘Fast Hands’ not working properly have been resolved and the perk will now function as intended
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Victim Endurance
[list]
[*] We have (once again) fixed an issue where the Victim Endurance stat did not feel noticeably different for players
[list]
[*] Victim’s total stamina capacity, stamina drain, and regeneration will now scale properly as players allocate more points into Endurance
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Cook Tagging Dead Bodies
[list]
[*] Cook’s Seek Ability was incorrectly highlighting dead bodies after using his Lovely Neck Execution 
[list]
[*] This has been fixed, and Cook’s Seek Ability will now only highlight alive Victims
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Cook Tagging Escaped Victims
[list]
[*] We have again fixed a bug where Cook could highlight Victims who have already escaped with his Seek Ability 
[*] Cook is now able to use his ability only on active playing Victims
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Close Encounters Door Interruption 
[list]
[*] We have resolved an issue where the Close Encounter animation would cancel out if a Family member opened or closed a nearby door
[*] Player can now engage in a Close Encounter near a door without this interruption
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game -  Hitchhiker Traps and Windows
[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue where if a Victim stepped in a Hitchhiker trap placed on the inside of a window, it would still activate the window jump cinematic and Victims would receive double the damage
[*] Victim players will no longer get stuck under the window in this scenario    
[/list]        

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Rough Cut Thrust
[list]
[*] An issue has been resolved where Victims who were hit with a thrust melee attack didn’t take damage over time from the perk ‘Rough Cut’
[*] Damage over time will now apply to a Victim when hit with a thrust with ‘Rough Cut’ equipped
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Noise Indicators Following Victims
[list]
[*] An issue has been fixed where Noise Indicators wouldn’t follow Victims after they’ve opened a sliding door
[/list]

[b]Fixed: [/b]Base Game - ‘Exterior Alarms’ Noise VFX
[list]
[*] We have resolved an issue where sliding doors wouldn’t produce noise VFX for victims if the Grandpa perk ‘Exterior Alarms’ was active
[*] Sliding doors will now produce noise VFX for victims at all times
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Stabbing Grandpa Prompt
[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue where the prompt for Victims to stab Grandpa wouldn’t populate from certain angles and distances
[*] Stabbing Grandpa will now feel more consistent for players
[/list]

[b]Fixed: [/b]Base Game - Lighting in Customization Menu 
[list]
[*] When players would go to the Customization Menu, the lighting was too bright and caused textures to go missing 
[*] The lighting is now correct in the menus and textures are no longer missing
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - ‘Heart Attack’ UI
[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue where the UI for Hands’ perk ‘Heart Attack’ was not proccing on a Barge hit  
[/list]

[b]Fixed: [/b]Base Game - Family Member Adjusting with Camera Movement
[list]
[*] An issue where Family Members were not correctly turning away when players faced their camera towards them has been resolved
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Living Room Collision
[list]
[*] We added collision to the side table in the Living Room
[/list]

[b]Fixed: [/b]‘Rush Week’ - Dining Room Collision
[list]
[*] We removed incorrect collision in the Dining Room that would prevent players from navigating between a side table and flower vase
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Sorority Girl Models
[list]
[*] A visual bug has been resolved where a seam line would appear on the Sorority Girl’s back or shoulder
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Opening Doors as Johnny
[list]
[*] We have resolved issues players were facing with doors not opening consistently for Johnny, despite pressing the correct inputs
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Perfume and Hunt Ability 
[list]
[*] When using the perfume on Johnny, it was not disabling his Hunt ability as described in the tutorial 
[*] Now, when a Johnny player steps into a perfume cloud, his Hunt ability is deactivated 
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Fusebox 
[list]
[*] When Johnny turns off the fusebox, the Sorority Girls were still able to make phone calls to the police 
[*] This has been fixed so that the prompt to turn off the fusebox was removed
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] ‘Rush Week’ - Anonymize Player Names 
[list]
[*] The Anonymize Player Names option would show all players in a Rush Week lobby who was Johnny 
[*] Players with Anonymize Player Names turned on will now see a “?” for everyone in the lobby 
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Victim UI 
[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue where the Victim UI for minigames would be visible to Family members 
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Health Potion UI
[list]
[*] Missing UI has been fixed for when Players would use a health item after canceling a mini-game
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Stuck After Canceling Minigame 
[list]
[*] There was an issue where if the Host of a lobby canceled out of a minigame and used a health potion afterwards, they would be softlocked 
[*] This has now been fixed 
[/list]

For any existing or persistent issues, please use the [url=support.txchainsawgame.com]support site[/url].

Thank you for reading the patch notes.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 26th, 2024
notes.content:
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/5fae949c-232a-46c5-ac95-5da9dbd6f09d/BBQ_SocialUpdates_PatchNotes_09_26_24.jpg?format=2500w[/img]

[b]The September 26th, 2024 patch will feature bug fixes and the release of ‘Rush Week.’[/b]

These are the bug fixes  for our September 26th, 2024 patch. It’s scheduled to begin rolling out on console and PC at roughly 8AM EDT. This patch will also include the release of our new, FREE game mode ‘Rush Week’. Folks who have purchased the Content Pass will gain access to ‘Rush Week’ four days earlier. It will be free to everyone on Monday, September 30th, 2024. 

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/03883960-faa9-4952-aa29-fd52d6e4f6e6/TCSM_RushWeek.jpg?format=2500w[/img]
As a reminder, in addition to the default cosmetics of Pajamas, Cheerleader, and Nightie, everyone who plays 'Rush Week' will unlock the Towel and Laundry Day cosmetics for FREE, for life! But you gotta be quick, as the offer only lasts until our October patch when the two cosmetics will move to the shop at $1.99 each. 

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/1ff5d611-7040-474b-b426-0ae96a184e8f/TCSM_RushWeek_Cosmetics_Five.png?format=2500w[/img]

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]
[b]Changed:[/b] Base Game - Fuse Box Spawn on The Mill
[list]
[*] We have changed a potential spawn location for fuse box, to prevent it from spawning too close in proximity to the valve tank
[*] Added fusebox spawn in the Mill Ground Floor
[*] Removed fusebox spawn in the Overgrown Exterior
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Connie’s Focused SFX 
[list]
[*] In both public and private matches, all players could hear Connie use her Focused ability 
[*] Players will no longer be able to hear a Connie pop their Focused ability 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game -  Lockpicking Exploit
[list]
[*] Victims were previously able to bypass tool break progression by exiting and reentering the minigame after hitting a checkpoint
[*] Tool break progress will fill and deplete normally now
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game -  Ripstall Cooldown
[list]
[*] The Level 2 Hands Ability Tree upgrade, Reduce Ripstall Cooldown, did not give the correct cooldown 
[*] With this fix, the cooldown will be 72 seconds if Reduce Ripstall Cooldown has been equipped 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Family Members Stunned 
[list]
[*] If any 2 Family Members stand near a hiding spot while a Victim bursts out of it, it would result in one Family player being permanently stunned for the rest of the match 
[*] This has been fixed so that the stun is the correct duration when a Victim player bursts out of a hiding spot 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - ‘Tracker Tagged’ Perk 
[list]
[*] The Family Perk ‘Tracker Tagged’ would lose functionality mid-match and not highlight Victims after landing a hit  
[list] [*] The description for the Tracker Tagged Perk reads as follows: “Hitting a Victim highlights them for all Family members. Highlight duration is 2/3/5 seconds.”
[/list] [*] The perk will now always highlight Victims for the proper duration for all Family Members after hitting a Victim 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game -  Maria’s Eye Color  
[list]
[*] Hazel, her eyes are hazel
[*] Nothing to see here 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Sonny Star Sign Ability
[list]
[*] When using Sonny’s ability, other players were able to see visual effects
[*] The effect will now only be visible to Sonny
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Base Game - Family Melee Attack Exploit
[list]
[*] The team has patched an exploit where Family players could deal double damage with a single melee attack
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Crashes 
[list]
[*] If the host of a private match had the store open while the lobby countdown transitioned to the loading screen, the title would crash for them 
[*] The game will no longer crash in this scenario 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Consecutive Matches
[list]
[*] Players were not able to play consecutive private matches as they would encounter an infinite loading screen if four or more players were present 
[*] This has now been fixed and players will be able to play back to back private matches regardless of player count 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches -  Family House - Blood Moon Basement Lighting 
[list]
[*] We fixed a shader issue on the Family House - Blood Moon map variant that resulted in the basement area being too bright
[*] Players can view this fix in private matches 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Spectator Overlay
[list]
[*] When hosting a private match as a Victim, proximity and hiding spot overlays would not be present for the host in spectator mode
[*] The correct visual effects will now show for the spectating player
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Family Stamina
[list]
[*] Family melee attacks were incorrectly consuming stamina in private matches
[*] Attacking as a Family Member will now consume the proper amount of stamina
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Attack Animations
[list]
[*] Repeated attacks by a Family Member in private matches would have identical animations
[*] Family Member attacks will now smoothly alternate between animations 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Bone Shards 
[list]
[*] An issue has been fixed where the host of a private match was able to collect an infinite amount of bone shards from bone piles
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Fuse Box Minigame
[list]
[*] Fuse box minigame would not complete properly resulting in the basement door not opening and the minigame remaining visible to the player
[*] Fuse box minigame will now function as intended when completed
[*] Quick math, on the other hand, can still be difficult
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches -  Character Levels
[list]
[*] Character levels were not displaying accurately to non host players
[*] The appropriate character level will now show for all players when in a private lobby
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Star Sign Ability Effects 
[list]
[*] We fixed an issue where the host of a private match could see the Star Sign Ability effects of other characters during a match, regardless of the side they were playing on
[*] Every character is bound to its own set of abilities and will not see the effects of other characters' Star Sign Abilities during private matches
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Attribute Points
[list]
[*] A fix has been implemented where Attribute Point changes made in the Character Loadout weren’t applying correctly during a private match
[*] The fix made Attribute Points properly reflected in the functionality during a private match
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Radio Voice Over 
[list]
[*] An issue has been fixed where the host couldn’t hear the radio voice over when loading into a private match
[*] Radio voice over is now audible for all players when loading into a private match
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Softlocked 
[list]
[*] We have fixed a bug where softlock occurred for the host of a private match if they loaded into a match with the Options Menu opened
[*] The host of a private match will now be able to enter a match without getting softlocked
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Leatherface Destroying Doors 
[list]
[*] We fixed a bug where the host of a private match would see a Padlock appear after Leatherface destroyed a door
[*] A padlock will not visibly appear after Leatherface destroys a door in Private Matches
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Victim Execution Sound Effects
[list]
[*] We have implemented a fix where a sound effect that is normally played after a Victim dies was present during the Loading Screen when starting a private match
[*] Victim death sound effects will now only play after a Victim is executed 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Private Matches - Non-Functional Lobbies 
[list]
[*] We have resolved an issue where players would get stuck in a non-functional private lobby while attempting to leave immediately after creating it 
[*] Players in a Private Match Lobby can now proceed to the main menu without any issues
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Museum Mode -  Photo Opportunity Mode Invisible Collision 
[list]
[*] When entering Photo Opportunity Mode after finishing Museum Mode, players would encounter invisible collision in the Front Field area 
[*] This issue has been fixed
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Museum Mode -  Stuck Spots
[list]
[*] In Museum Mode’s Photo Opportunity Mode, if a player tried to change Family Members while standing on top of them in the Car Graveyard, they would get stuck out of bounds 
[*] This issue has been fixed
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Museum Mode - Camera Stuck Spot 
[list]
[*] The camera in Museum Mode would get stuck in the map environments when attempting to switch characters in a staged photo opportunity in the Basement Area 
[*] Player camera will no longer get stuck while switching characters 
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Museum Mode - Inverted Functionality

As mentioned in our [url=https://www.txchainsawgame.com/hub/skill-tree-reworks]Skill Tree Reworks Community Hub pos[/url]t, the team has been working on how to make Grandpa perks function differently in game. We aim to both freshen up gameplay and give more utility to feeding Grandpa, a mechanic that hasn’t quite hit the mark we intended. 

We’ve decided to place Grandpa perks into certain level categories. These levels will then be tied to Grandpa’s Family Bond Level in order for it to unlock and proc. A Level One Grandpa perk will only become available to Family once they feed Grandpa up to Level One. We wanted Grandpa to play a bigger role in each match and we are excited to see how Family players strategize their builds accordingly.

Players should keep in mind that if your team only brings Level Three Grandpa Perks, none of them will unlock until your team has fed Grandpa to get Level Three. These perks would then all unlock at the same time.

notes.title: Meet Hands
notes.content:
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/1f5268ae-dff9-49b8-a0cb-d596c3cdcc7c/TCSM_MeetHands_CommunityHub.png?format=2500w[/img]

Hailing from the bible of Kim Henkel, Hands is a distant cousin to the Slaughter Family. The talented Robert Mukes (House of a 1000 Corpses) brings this 7ft tall, nearly 350 lbs, to life. Armed with a hammer and electronic traps, Robert makes Hands a force to be reckoned with. 

While Hands is a drag racing legend in Texas, what residents in town don’t know is that he’s got a dark, violent, and gruesome nature. He’s the type of man who gets into grisly altercations at sleazy, run-down biker hangouts. During one of these fights, Hands beats a man to death, rips his face off, and proceeds to wear it as some kind of sick joke. This comes as no surprise as Hands is massive, extremely powerful, and can and will kill you with his bare hands in minutes. 

After that altercation, Uncle Hands gives this human “mask” trophy to Leatherface, inadvertently creating a lifelong obsession for the kid. 

[i]“Being able to work with Kim Henkel to bring his original vision of Hands to life from his character bible has been both gratifying and amazing. Honoring authenticity and adding more layers to the lore of The Texas Chain Saw Massacre has been a dream come true. I hope players will find him as terrifying and brutal as I do.” [/i]
- Ronnie Hobbs, Creative Director, Gun Interactive 

Aside from wielding a hammer, players will find Hands to be a great asset to any Family team composition. Hands specializes in locking down areas, such as using his homemade electro traps to booby trap barricades, crawlspaces, and other metal objects.

Since Hands knows the ins and outs of machines, his Ripstall ability can be used to physically rip out valves and fuses, as well as being able to start the generator or battery quickly. If all else fails, Hands can use his body to take on a defensive stance. Anyone silly enough to approach him runs the risk of being knocked down by a well-timed barge.

[i]“I am so excited for folks to see what I brought to the table with Hands. The Texas Chain Saw Massacre is one of my all time favorite horror movies. I first saw it at 12 years old and thought it was a documentary because it felt so real. It’s amazing that I now get to work with an IP that means so much to me. With Kane Hodder doing stunt coordination, I had a blast mo-capping Hands as I used his hammer to bash Victims upside the head”[/i]
- Robert Mukes, Actor 

Hands will be arriving to The Texas Chain Saw Massacre on June 11th, 2024. 

Thank you for reading!

notes.title: Meet Virginia
notes.content:
We are very excited to share more details about our newest addition to the Victim roster, Virginia. Barbara Crampton, horror legend and icon, will be voicing Virginia, and her character will also have her likeness! 

Virginia is a grief-stricken mother who cannot get over the disappearance of her son Jesse. She’s obsessive over his vanishing and refuses to believe that he could be gone. The weight of her pain is so immense she leaves behind her nursing career to move to Newt, TX, the last location Jesse was seen. Out of determination and desperation, she travels alone to remote areas in hopes of finding him. She even goes so far as to talk to anyone who could possibly have information on Jesse’s whereabouts. This eventually leads to Virginia spotting some unusual behavior near a remote farmhouse. With hope in her heart that she’ll find Jesse, her investigation of the property leads to her tragic run-in with The Family. Captured and trapped in a different kind of nightmare, Virginia will use her vast knowledge of homemade remedies to escape.

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/0ec9b804-c15e-44a5-96e1-c2b328d95282/MeetVirginia_HubPost_Turnaround.png?format=2500w[/img]

Virginia’s time as a nurse allows her to see Sissy’s flower powder and make special concoctions that she can use to possibly save her own life. With this mixture, she can throw it directly at a Family member to create a blue cloud that temporarily blinds them. This will buy Virginia and the other Victims time to run away and possibly live to see another day. Her special ability, Boon, can also be used to contaminate blood buckets on the property. If a Family member gathers blood from one of these buckets, they will be disoriented for a short amount of time.

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/619bf07d441a6f3f704eb0d8/5b4902d6-c8df-41c9-9a0e-b9aed7632316/MeetVirginia_HubPost_Screenshot+%281%29.png?format=2500w[/img]

With Barabara Crampton loving The Texas Chain Saw Massacre as much as we do at Gun Interactive, working on Virginia has been a rewarding creative endeavor for all of us. 

[i]“Gunnar Hansen was my friend so it’s been a great experience to keep the wonderful legacy of The Texas Chain Saw Massacre going with my inclusion in this game. Working with all the folks at GUN on my new DLC character has been a remarkable experience! They are among the best in the business. I’m so proud of what they have created and excited for everyone to see all the new stuff!” [/i]
- Barbara Crampton, Actor, Producer

We still have so much more to share about Virginia; so, stay tuned to our official subreddit, [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/TXChainSawGame/]r/TXChainSawGame[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TXChainSawGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/txchainsawgame/?hl=en]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/TXChainSawGame]Facebook[/url].

Exploiting the game
Cheating
Offensive name or profile 
Spamming chat

Abusive voice or chat communications 
Other
